summary.headline: Julian of Laodicea’s Astrological Works
summary.text: Discussion of Julian of Laodicea’s use of Ptolemy’s astronomical numbers, the dating of his observations, and his distinction from the two theurgic Julians. It lists surviving excerpts and manuscripts of his works, including Astronomical Investigation, chapters on war, and chapters on the conditions of the seven stars and beginnings.
